title: The Book of Formation (Sepher Yetzirah)
subtitle: Translated from the Hebrew, with annotations, by Knut Stenring, including the 32 Paths of Wisdom, their correspondence with the Hebrew alphabet and the Tarot symbols; with an Introduction by Arthur Edward Waite
author: Rabbi Akiba ben Joseph
publicDomain: Published 1923: in the public domain in the US since 1 January 2019.
note: Stenring's translation of 1923, the one Paul Case quotes, set from the scan of Cornell University Library's copy and read line by line against its pages, the Hebrew letter by letter against Stenring's own transliteration. The printer's own slips are kept as printed. Stenring's Notes on the Book of Formation (pp. 36–57) are not yet set here.
